angles: Local-first CI verification: run AgentProof-style checks inside CI on the AI-generated diff before merge, keeping code/data on-prem instead of shipping to a cloud observability SaaS
The trust gap: AI code passes functional tests but fails security/behavior checks — verification must be diff-scoped and automated, not post-hoc
Verification before merge vs. observability after deploy: catch vulnerabilities in the PR rather than finding them in production
Cost/privacy angle: local-first avoids per-event cloud fees and data retention on third-party servers
Human review cannot scale to AI diff volume — automated CI verification is the only realistic control (45%/55% insecurity stat)
